summary: Phase 4 testing (backend + frontend). New pytest suite test_phase4_screens.py: 16 passed, 2 failed, 2 skipped. The 2 skips are free-plan Finder league cap tests; billing is off, so the test user is Pro with finder_leagues=-1. UI working: Insights grid, stat/scope/tier filters and empty state; Finder (league chips, free-plan replace as anonymous, Likelihood/Form/Run, team/player scope, venue, positions, filters kept in the URL across reload, Reset, empty state); Search via header icon (hint under 2 letters, 'sev'/'inter' results with crests/avatars, links go to the team page); Following signed-out prompt; follow-team/follow-player then Follows list, Upcoming feed (30 fixtures) and unfollow; save star then Saved list then unsave; player note save, reload, empty save removes it; Track record shows tr-not-ready, 0 of 300; Share card downloads Sevilla-v-Osasuna.png, valid PNG 1200x630, crests drawn, toast 'Share card saved as an image', no error. Mobile 390px: no page overflow on insights/finder/search/following/track-record/match/team/player/league. Bugs: (1) Saved and feed forecasts are not decorated, so cards show 'Team' with a placeholder crest; (2) Finder shows stale rows ('undefined of undefined games') after a mode switch; (3) /auth/me counts toward the 10/min auth rate limit, so a few page reloads make a signed-in user look signed out and the Follow/Save buttons send them to sign-in; (4) the SaveButton never loads its saved state.

critical.issue: /api/auth/* shares the 'auth' group, limit security.rate_limit_auth_per_minute=10 per IP. Every full page load calls /auth/me (twice in dev StrictMode). After about 5 reloads in a minute it returns 429. auth.js refresh() keeps the previous user on 429, but on a fresh page load there is no previous user, so it falls back to {user:null}. The user then looks signed out: header shows Sign in, and FollowButton/SaveButton redirect to /sign-in. Reproduced twice in Playwright; backend log has 30x 'GET /api/auth/me 429'.

minor.issue: items[].forecast is the raw forecast doc with no player/team/opp names (Q._decorate not applied). The UI card shows 'Team' and a placeholder shield.
forecasts[] get only player names; team/opp are missing. Team-scope cards show 'Team', and player cards show 'Midfielder ·  · date' with no team v opp.
Some rows have tier=null (20 of 100 for shots 1+ in Serie A) next to 'Watch' rows. Check that null tier is intended.
Only team-scope forecasts come back (13 rows, none for players), so the Insights 'Players' filter is always empty right now. This is a data or tier fact; just flagging it.

ui_bugs.issue: After a Likelihood search, switching mode to Form/Run without searching again renders the old rows with the new mode's Result component: '1 or more in undefined of undefined games'. Results should be cleared, or tied to the mode they were fetched with, whenever filters change.

`on` always starts false. A saved forecast shows an empty star after reload and in the Saved list itself; pressing it PUTs again instead of removing. It should load the saved fkeys, e.g. one shared /me/saved fetch in context, like FollowButton does per item.
Uses STATS (Goals/Assists) for teams too and never offers Corners, although TEAM_STATS exists and Insights has team corners forecasts. Use TEAM_STATS when scope=team.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is rate-limited (10 auth requests/min/IP, which includes /auth/me). In Playwright, wait for the sign-in form to hydrate, then navigate client-side with history.pushState + popstate instead of page.goto, or you will get 429 and appear signed out. Billing is off, so the test user is Pro (finder_leagues=-1); the free-plan one-league replace only shows when anonymous. Insights currently has only 13 team forecasts. The share PNG verified 1200x630 via a download event (navigator.canShare is undefined in headless).
rca of the issue: Signed-out-after-reloads: SessionMiddleware puts GET /api/auth/me in the 'auth' group (limit 10/min/IP). On a cold load, AuthProvider.refresh() gets a 429; prev state is null, so setMe keeps {user:null}, and useGate() then redirects to /sign-in on Follow/Save. Repro: sign in, then reload pages about 6 times within 60s; the header shows 'Sign in'. Mitigation: exempt /auth/me from the auth group and retry on 429 in refresh().
